description: Named coastal planning areas for both apps. Geographic sources identify places, not guaranteed fishing access, permission, catches or launch facilities.

protection_review.method: Point-in-polygon screening against DOC marine reserve, south-east reserve and Hauraki Gulf marine protection layers. Any overlap is excluded conservatively. This does not assess routes, adjacent coast, all fishing restrictions, temporary closures, rahui or physical access.
